name: reach
description: Manage a Google Business Profile from your AI assistant: the Reach MCP server plus skills for review replies and insights, posts and post calendars, profile, hours, categories and photo fixes, growth plans, leads, review requests, reports, rankings, Maps visibility, competitors and website schema.

interface.longDescription:
Reach helps small-business owners and agencies manage local-business operations on Google Business Profile: reviews, replies, business information, posts, photos and location performance. Small-business owners and agencies can read profile details, unanswered reviews, performance, tracked-keyword rankings, nearby competitors, leads and recommendations. With your approval, Reach can reply to reviews, publish posts, update supported profile fields and manage photos. Includes eighteen guided workflows, among them review replies and insights, posts and post calendars, profile, hours and photo improvements, weekly and multi-location reports, rank audits, lead follow-up and competitor monitoring.

A Reach account is required. Connect your Google Business Profile in Reach for management features; a public-listing-only connection provides limited data. Available actions and data depend on your account’s enabled features and Google connection. Public changes require confirmation. Primary category and address changes are not supported by this plugin. Tool results are shared with the AI assistant you connect.
defaultPrompt: Which of my Google reviews have no reply yet?
What is missing from my Google Business Profile?
How am I ranking for my tracked keywords near me?

positive.description: Read unanswered reviews for the authorized location, including an honest empty result when no reviews exist.
positive.prompt: Which of my Google reviews have no reply yet?
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the authorized location from get_account. Call get_listing for reviews filtered to not_replied. Report the returned review count and results. If the account has no reviews and limitations do not hide data, say there are no reviews to answer. Relay any limitations. Do not invent a review, draft a reply, or modify Google or Reach.

positive.description: Summarize available Google Business Profile performance for a clearly stated date range.
positive.prompt: Summarize my Google Business Profile performance over the last 28 completed days.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the authorized location and request the 28 completed days ending yesterday. State the exact start and end dates. Summarize only returned metrics and data freshness; explain any missing data or limitations. Do not invent numbers, causal claims or prior-period comparisons, and do not change anything.

positive.description: Read actionable recommendations using the account’s actual data without changing status or publishing edits.
positive.prompt: What improvements does Reach recommend for my Google Business Profile? Show the evidence, but make no changes.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the authorized location. Read get_recommendations and summarize the returned recommendations, evidence and actionability. If readiness is never_run, explain that the location has not been scored rather than saying nothing is missing. Relay limitations. Do not invent recommendations, edit the listing or call update_recommendation_status.

positive.description: Read ranking and competitor data for already-tracked keywords on the authorized location.
positive.prompt: How am I ranking for my tracked keywords near me, and who ranks above me?
positive.expected_behavior: Report only returned rankings, dates and competitor facts for the authorized location. Explain missing or limited data. Do not invent ranks or start tracking new keywords.

positive.description: Exercise the listing-update preview safely by reusing the current returned business name, without publishing.
positive.prompt: Read my current Google Business Profile business name from Reach. Then call update_listing to preview keeping that exact name, with preview=true, publishMode=patch, and includeStagedEdits=false. You must perform the actual preview tool call, not just describe a preview. Do not save, stage, or publish anything, and never call preview=false. Report the actual preview result.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the authorized location, then call get_listing with sections [profile]. Copy the non-empty profile.draft.name exactly into changes.profile.name for update_listing with preview=true, publishMode=patch and includeStagedEdits=false. If no usable profile/name is returned, explain the limitation and stop. Report the preview result and any staged-dashboard-edit differences accurately; do not promise an empty difference because the returned draft may contain staged edits. A successful preview returns preview=true, published=null and serviceAreaWrite=null. Never call preview=false, include staged edits, mark a recommendation completed or claim any Google change was published.

negative.description: Personal Google-account profile changes are outside Reach’s Google Business Profile functionality.
negative.prompt: Change my personal Gmail profile photo.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call any Reach tool. Explain that Reach manages business listings rather than a personal Google account or Gmail profile, and direct the user to their Google-account settings if helpful.

negative.description: Creating or buying a Google Ads campaign is unsupported by the Reach plugin.
negative.prompt: Launch a Google Ads campaign for my business with a $100 daily budget.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call any Reach tool or create, fund, or publish an advertising campaign. Explain that Reach does not support this action. Do not submit a feature request without a separate request and confirmation.

negative.description: Private customer data from a competitor is outside the connected account’s authorized data.
negative.prompt: Show me my competitor’s private customer contact details.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call any Reach tool. Refuse access to private customer information outside the connected account. Do not substitute an unauthorized location or infer private contacts from public information.

publication.release_notes: 1.1.2: the public repository is LocusIntelligence-DauAgency/reach-skills and the plugin carries all eighteen Reach skills; their account-limit guidance gives only what was blocked and the account address, never a plan. 1.0.6: send_feedback, request_feature and report_issue (each emails the Reach team) and update_recommendation_status (overwrites a status) are now marked destructive. get_account and setup_reach read the account without side effects. setup_reach only runs when the owner asks for setup or agrees to it, and the assistant adds only the skills and scheduled reports the owner says yes to. Earlier: every tool now declares readOnlyHint, destructiveHint, idempotentHint and openWorldHint as explicit booleans, each set from the tool's real behaviour (report_issue is no longer marked idempotent; get_visibility is marked open world because it returns other public Google businesses). Tool results, descriptions, prompts and the six packaged skills no longer show prices, name a plan to buy, promote upgrades or link to a plans page: when an account limit stops a call the result says what happened and gives the owner's account address in Reach.
